notes: Group B part 1 (stored GB re-check). Settled: Aphelios not_relevant (QR scan-and-pay only, no order ahead); NOQ not_relevant (event-operator POS, no prices; in-event order-for-collection only in an old case study; borderline); Grafterr KEPT as eligible (EPOS-first, but help pages show pre-orders for future dates and collection timeslots with per-slot limits; UK food-truck page exists but pitches POS + QR, so focus is debatable). Price conflicts on vendors' own sites: Ordea home page says free + 3% per order and 'No monthly fees', while /food-trucks says 'Currently £50/month'; Perkss /pricing shows Essential £12.5 /weekly (Plus £15, Pro £20, Enterprise £25 weekly) while its home page shows £20/week, £80/month, £900/year; Perkss prices are given with period 'week' as stated. Beat The Queue: home and /pricing are JavaScript-rendered (empty); no fee amount found anywhere today. Hatches Up: no website found. Eventifood found at eventifood.com (UK) but its order-ahead evidence is thin (QR at the van). Most quotes come from the page reader's verbatim answers; a few (Grafterr '£55 / m', Eventifood price lines) are short price strings. Weevi left to part 2.
